about: The plugin market's list (docs/PLUGINS.md). To publish a plugin, open a pull request adding one entry: id, name, description (as {language: text}), author, version, homepage, download (an https zip of the plugin folder) and sha256 (of that zip). `python scripts/plugin.py check <folder>` must pass.

description.en: China's talent programmes: what a city, province, university or employer offers, who qualifies, and when to apply.
